name: readr
resume: Edition 2 reads and writes delimited text in Python. Types are guessed the way vroom guesses them, so whole numbers are doubles. Time zones use zoneinfo. read_rds and write_rds use digest's version-2 serializer. read_builtin loads a named dataset from a package lazy-load database. Compression code 3 is raw LZMA2 with a 5-byte header.

functions.name: as.col_spec
functions.done: A short string becomes one collector per letter.

functions.name: clipboard
functions.done: Edition 2 pastes the clipboard into one string.

functions.name: col_character
functions.done: Keeps the field as text.

functions.name: col_date
functions.done: Parses a date with an optional format.

functions.name: col_datetime
functions.done: Parses a date and time with an optional format.

functions.name: col_double
functions.done: Parses a field as a double.

functions.name: col_factor
functions.done: Restricts values to a level set.

functions.name: col_guess
functions.done: Lets the reader choose the type.

functions.name: col_integer
functions.done: Parses a field as a 32-bit integer.

functions.name: col_logical
functions.done: Parses the strict true and false spellings.

functions.name: col_number
functions.done: Parses a number that may contain a currency mark or grouping.

functions.name: col_skip
functions.done: Drops the column.

functions.name: col_time
functions.done: Parses a time of day.

functions.name: cols
functions.done: Pairs column names with collectors. The default is a guess.

functions.name: cols_condense
functions.done: The most common collector becomes the default. Ties use the alphabetically first kind.

functions.name: cols_only
functions.done: Every column that is not named is skipped.

functions.name: count_fields
functions.done: Uses the tokenizer, and a csv tokenizer skips a blank line.

functions.name: datasource
functions.done: Records skip, comments, and whether blank rows are ignored. The default keeps blank rows.

functions.name: date_names
functions.done: Stores month names, weekday names, and the AM/PM marks. Weekdays start on Sunday.

functions.name: date_names_lang
functions.done: Looks up the ICU date symbols shipped with readr.

functions.name: date_names_langs
functions.done: Lists the language codes in the bundled symbol table.

functions.name: default_locale
functions.done: The locale stored in the readr.default_locale option. The default is US English, UTF-8, and UTC.

functions.name: edition_get
functions.done: Edition 2 is the default outside a package that asks for edition 1.

functions.name: format_csv
functions.done: Doubles use the short grisu3 form. A comma inside a field is quoted.

functions.name: format_csv2
functions.done: The decimal mark is a comma and the field separator is a semicolon.

functions.name: format_delim
functions.done: Writes a header and a trailing newline. Missing values are bare NA.

functions.name: format_tsv
functions.done: Fields are separated by a tab.

functions.name: fwf_cols
functions.done: Names are the column names and the values are widths.

functions.name: fwf_empty
functions.done: A run of two spaces ends a field. The last end is missing so the field runs to the end of the line.

functions.name: fwf_positions
functions.done: Start and end are 1-based and the end is inclusive.

functions.name: fwf_widths
functions.done: Widths are measured from the start of the line.

functions.name: guess_encoding
functions.done: ASCII input is reported as ASCII with confidence 1. Other input uses stringi and keeps encodings above the threshold.

functions.name: guess_parser
functions.done: Edition 2 guesses double, never integer. A mixed column stays character.

functions.name: local_edition
functions.done: The edition lasts until the surrounding function or with-block ends.

functions.name: locale
functions.done: The default locale is UTF-8 and UTC. The decimal mark and the grouping mark must differ.

functions.name: output_column
functions.done: A datetime is written in UTC as ISO-8601 with a trailing Z.

functions.name: parse_character
functions.done: Trims whitespace and turns the missing-value strings into NA.

functions.name: parse_date
functions.done: The default format is a calendar date. A day that is not on the calendar is missing.

functions.name: parse_datetime
functions.done: An offset is converted to UTC.

functions.name: parse_double
functions.done: A trailing letter is a failed double, not a partial number.

functions.name: parse_factor
functions.done: Known levels stay in the given order. Anything else is missing.

functions.name: parse_guess
functions.done: A column of whole numbers is parsed as double.

functions.name: parse_integer
functions.done: Leading zeros are accepted. A value past the 32-bit range is missing.

functions.name: parse_logical
functions.done: Accepts T, F, TRUE, and FALSE in either case. The digits 1 and 0 are not logical.

functions.name: parse_number
functions.done: A currency sign and grouping marks are removed before the number is read.

functions.name: parse_time
functions.done: The result is seconds since midnight. A fractional second on an hours-minutes-seconds time is dropped.

functions.name: parse_vector
functions.done: Applies one collector to a character vector and records problems on the result.

functions.name: problems
functions.done: Each problem has a row, a column, the expected type, and the text that failed.

check.case: a letter in a double column

functions.name: read_builtin
functions.done: Loads one named object from a package lazy-load database.

functions.name: read_csv
functions.done: Edition 2 guesses doubles. Repeated names are repaired so every copy gets a position suffix.

functions.name: read_csv2
functions.done: A comma is the decimal mark. When the decimal mark is already a dot, readr switches and says so.

functions.name: read_csv2_chunked
functions.done: The chunks are read with the edition 2 parser and then handed to the callback.

functions.name: read_csv_chunked
functions.done: The callback sees each chunk. A data-frame callback stacks them.

functions.name: read_delim
functions.done: Edition 2 takes the width from the first record and glues extra fields into the last column.

functions.name: read_delim_chunked
functions.done: Same parser as read_delim, then the callback.

functions.name: read_file
functions.done: Returns one string, line endings included.

functions.name: read_file_raw
functions.done: Returns one byte per character of the input.

functions.name: read_fwf
functions.done: Widths are trimmed when trim_ws is true.

functions.name: read_lines
functions.done: The default does not treat the text NA as missing. An empty line stays empty.

functions.name: read_lines_chunked
functions.done: Each chunk is a small table with one character column.

functions.name: read_lines_raw
functions.done: Each line is a vector of byte values, without the line ending.

functions.name: read_lines_raw_chunked
functions.done: Each chunk holds raw lines. This check reports the length of the first line in each chunk.

functions.name: read_log
functions.done: A hyphen is missing. Names are X1 onward because the file has no header.

functions.name: read_rds
functions.done: Version 2 RDS, including gzip, bzip2, and xz wrappers.

functions.name: read_table
functions.done: One or more spaces separate fields.

functions.name: read_tsv
functions.done: The delimiter is a tab. Types are guessed the same way as read_csv.

functions.name: read_tsv_chunked
functions.done: The chunks use the tab delimiter.

functions.name: readr_example
functions.done: The examples are the files shipped in inst/extdata.

functions.name: readr_threads
functions.done: The option readr.num_threads wins. Otherwise the VROOM_THREADS environment variable, then the CPU count.

functions.name: should_read_lazy
functions.done: The default is eager. The option readr.read_lazy asks for a lazy read.

functions.name: should_show_types
functions.done: TRUE and FALSE follow the option. An unset option leaves the decision to the caller.

functions.name: show_progress
functions.done: Progress is off unless the option is TRUE and the session is interactive.

functions.name: spec
functions.done: The specification is stored on the data frame returned by a reader.

functions.name: spec_csv
functions.done: Guesses from the file without returning the rows. Edition 1 guessing is forced for spec helpers.

functions.name: spec_csv2
functions.done: Uses a semicolon and a comma decimal mark.

functions.name: spec_delim
functions.done: The delimiter is the one you pass.

functions.name: spec_table
functions.done: Columns are separated by spaces.

functions.name: spec_tsv
functions.done: The delimiter is a tab.

functions.name: stop_for_problems
functions.done: Returns the data when there are no problems and raises when there is at least one.

functions.name: tokenize
functions.done: A csv tokenizer skips a blank line. Each record is a character vector.

functions.name: tokenizer_csv
functions.done: Comma delimiter, doubled quotes, and blank rows skipped.

functions.name: tokenizer_delim
functions.done: The delimiter is the one you pass.

functions.name: tokenizer_fwf
functions.done: Begin and end positions are stored on the tokenizer.

functions.name: tokenizer_line
functions.done: Each line is one field. The default missing set is empty.

functions.name: tokenizer_log
functions.done: Splits a combined log line. Whitespace trimming follows the argument.

functions.name: tokenizer_tsv
functions.done: The delimiter is a tab and blank rows are skipped.

functions.name: tokenizer_ws
functions.done: Fields are split on runs of whitespace.

functions.name: type_convert
functions.done: Character columns are guessed again. Whole numbers become doubles.

functions.name: with_edition
functions.done: Edition 1 pads a short row. Edition 2 glues extra fields into the last column. Python takes a callable.

check.case: short first row under both editions

functions.name: write_csv
functions.done: The file matches format_csv, including the trailing newline.

functions.name: write_csv2
functions.done: Decimal commas and a semicolon separator.

functions.name: write_delim
functions.done: The delimiter is the one you pass.

functions.name: write_excel_csv
functions.done: The file starts with the UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8.

functions.name: write_excel_csv2
functions.done: A byte order mark, semicolon separators, and comma decimals.

functions.name: write_file
functions.done: The bytes are written as given, with no extra newline.

functions.name: write_lines
functions.done: Missing values become the na string. A separator follows the last line.

functions.name: write_rds
functions.done: Version 2 with compress none matches saveRDS. gzip is compared after it is opened.

functions.name: write_tsv
functions.done: Fields are separated by a tab.
